newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa June CPI figures expected week after next.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa June CPI figures expected week after next.

text.p: South Africa's Central Statistical Service (CSS) said on Friday June's Consumer Price Index figures were only likely to be released in the last week of July.
"It's definitely not coming out next week. I would expect it the week after that," a CSS spokeswoman told Reuters.
Many economists had expected the data to be released next week.
CPI rose 0.6 percent in May from April, giving a year-on-year rise of 9.5 percent.
